caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock with a rectangular base and body, topped with a circular clock face that displays Roman numerals and two black clock hands. The clock case is colored in shades of brown, imitating the texture and grain of wood, with panel details on the front. Positioned atop the clock case is a small human figurine with a blue-green upper body, tan-colored pants, and brown shoes. The figurine is holding a long stick supporting a large dark gray or black bowl or dome above its head. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Plantation Clock
